trigger-beta-verification.estimateReason: One serial Trigger Rust test, LLVM coverage or native verification build, using persistent disk-backed Cargo caches. Allows 8 GiB cache/output growth plus 1 GiB scratch, including two simultaneous 256 MiB portable-state files, and preserves an 8 GiB free-space reserve. Retained budget includes ordinary, LLVM and native build outputs; reusable caches require explicit direction before removal.
